title: Ringed pullback kflat
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal C'$ be small sites with sheaves of commutative rings $\mathcal O$ on $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal O\prime$ on $\mathcal C\prime$, respectively, let $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C')\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi, meaning an adjoint pair $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits, and let $c:u^{-1}\mathcal O\to\mathcal O'$ be a map of sheaves of commutative rings. On module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] put $u^*M=u^{-1}M\otimes_{u^{-1}\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If $P$ is a K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] of $\mathcal O$-module sheaves and all its terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then $u^*P$ is a K-flat complex of $\mathcal O'$-module sheaves and all its terms are flat. No flatness of $c$ is required.
